card.name: Adjective endings inside long words
card.fires_on: The ending piece (-ally, -ologically, -ual, -ar) that finishes an adjective or adverb built on a medical or scientific stem, such as nutrition, pharmac, percept or cerebell.

modes.label: Adverb endings
modes.description: The -ally or -ologically ending completing an adverb after a stem like nutrition, education or pharmac.

modes.label: Cerebellar ending
modes.description: The -ar ending closing the word cerebellar before syndrome, dysfunction or toxicity.
modes.example: Fluorouracil can cause acute cerebell<<ar>> syndrome

card.writes: It pushes toward word-ending pieces like ITY and ities, so it seems to help finish long suffixed words.
card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a long adjective or adverb, like the end of cerebellar or nutritionally.
